name: com.heydavidmorales/portfolio
title: Remote Jobs & Contact Center Staffing (ShyftOff) · David Morales
description: ShyftOff remote CS jobs ($14–$20/hr, 30-min shifts) and contact center staffing, by David Morales

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: David Morales's summary: current role, location, headline stats, and the principles he works by.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Tools David has built (Agent Journey Tracker, NetViz Sandbox, CRA Scout) with what each does, how it was built, and whether it is public.

tools.name: get_experience
tools.description: David's roles from 2022 to today, newest first, with dates and highlights. Optionally filter by company.

company.description: Only return roles at this company.

tools.name: get_role_fit
tools.description: The kinds of roles, industries, and work arrangements David is best suited for, with his core strengths. Use to judge fit for an operations, support, or quality role.

tools.name: get_recruiter_faq
tools.description: Short factual answers to common recruiter and hiring-manager questions: current role, years of experience, results, people development, systems, technical depth, location, contact.

tools.name: get_shyftoff_opportunities
tools.description: Two ShyftOff opportunities, with links. For job seekers: ongoing work-from-home customer service (phone, chat, email) at $14–$20 an hour, paid weekly, in shifts as short as 30 minutes with no minimum hours, no experience required, paid certification with no certification fee (a one-time $40 background check fee that ShyftOff pays back once agents start working), and growth into QA and Star status; includes pages for college students (18+) and for fast food, restaurant and retail workers adding a second job, common questions (is ShyftOff legit, weekly pay timing, certification pay, computer requirements, hours, login and support), plus David's referral sign-up link. For businesses, BPOs and contact centers: on-demand agents certified on your program during implementation, improved with performance data, low performers removed, billed per productive hour, with or without AI, plus David's ShyftOff email. Use when the user asks about ShyftOff, about remote customer service or call center work through ShyftOff, or about contact center staffing through ShyftOff.

audience.description: "agents" for people looking for remote customer service work, "businesses" for companies that need agent capacity. Omit for both.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Keyword search across every published page on heydavidmorales.com: the portfolio, ShyftOff job and staffing pages, and the guides. Returns the best-matching sections with a snippet and link.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "background check fee", "30-minute shifts", "volume spikes".

tools.name: check_eligibility
tools.description: Quick self-check against ShyftOff's published requirements for remote customer service agents: 18+, in the US, a modern computer, a USB headset, wired internet at 25 Mbps+, and a quiet private space. No experience required. Returns what's met, what's missing with how to fix it, next steps and David's referral sign-up link. Pass whatever the person has told you; unknown items are listed for them to confirm.

in_us.description: Whether they live in the United States.

has_computer.description: Has a modern computer (many programs ask for Windows 11 with 8 GB RAM).

has_usb_headset.description: Has a USB headset with a noise-cancelling microphone.

internet_mbps.description: Internet speed in Mbps, if known.

has_quiet_space.description: Has a quiet, private place to work.

tools.name: estimate_earnings
tools.description: Estimates weekly, monthly and yearly earnings for ShyftOff remote customer service work at $14–$20 an hour for a given number of hours a week (shifts can be as short as 30 minutes, no minimum hours, paid weekly). Before taxes; agents are 1099 contractors.

hours_per_week.description: Hours a week the person wants to work, e.g. 10.

tools.name: plan_staffing
tools.description: For brands, BPOs and contact centers: turns a team's needs (channels, agents needed, weekly volume, peak period, AI or not, industry, platform) into a short ShyftOff plan (implementation, agent pipeline, go-live, improvement), the relevant notes on timing, pricing model and compliance, and a ready-to-send intro email to David at ShyftOff.

channels.description: Channels to cover, e.g. "phone and chat".

weekly_contacts.description: Roughly how many contacts a week.

peak_period.description: Peak or deadline, e.g. "open enrollment in November".

uses_ai.description: Whether the team uses AI agents today.

ccaas.description: Contact center platform, e.g. Genesys, Five9, NICE, Talkdesk.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: How to reach David: email, LinkedIn, and a link to his resume PDF.
